# awscontrib Provider

A focused provider for AWS capabilities that are not available in the HashiCorp AWS or AWS Cloud Control providers.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    awscontrib = {
      source = "hans-m-song/awscontrib"
    }
  }
}

provider "awscontrib" {
  profile = "example"
  region  = "ap-southeast-2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `profile` (String) AWS shared configuration profile to use.
- `region` (String) AWS Region to use. When omitted, the AWS SDK resolves the Region from its default configuration chain.
